<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
We found a strange lobster,
so we came to report!

This lobster,
its right hand is a thin, sharp claw,
its left hand is like a cat's paw...

This is, how to put it,
like the hands of someone using a knife.

One might call it the Cook Lobster.
This is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
A huge discovery!
